cardinality_bound: Every residue class contributes at most four ordered boundary pairs; total at most 4P.
claim: For every ell>=1 and d>=ell, the extended boundary set of p(n)=v2(n+1) mod 2 is invariant under replacing d by d+2^(1+ceil(log2(ell))).
domain: ell positive integer, d integer at least ell, i any nonnegative integer; both boundary windows length ell
unproved_limits: least boundary period for all ell
sharp cardinality of all boundary sets
valuation_holes: At positions j+1 divisible by P, p(j)=(ceil(log2(ell))+v2((j+1)/P)) mod 2; ordinary letters determined mod P.
